verdict.rationale: Cline's pricing page explicitly states 'You're never locked into our platform or pricing... self-host anytime' (cline-docs-15), and the core VS Code/CLI tooling is open-source and run locally with your own API keys (cline-docs-27), supporting a self-host narrative. However, there is no technical documentation (deployment guide, Docker image, server requirements) describing how to self-host the Kanban hub/scheduling backend, and no independent corroboration of self-hosting in practice. Missing for 10: dedicated self-hosting docs/guide, evidence of self-hosted hub/backend infrastructure, and community validation of a real self-hosted deployment.
